title: Border frame payload
summary: JSON Schema for the border frame detector payload - per-side widths in source px, style, colour or gradient, inner corner radius and content rectangle.
description: Emitted as the envelope payload by video_re_detect_border_frame; the envelope itself follows the baltor.video-detection/v1 schema.

review.notes: Valid example validates and invalid example fails (Draft 2020-12); the detector's tests validate every emitted payload against this schema.
